title: chore(examples): add app style for word wrap in e-commerce demo
body:
**Summary**

This adds style to `app.css` to wrap words.
It fixes the glitches (1) and (2) from [here](https://github.com/algolia/angular-instantsearch/pull/629#issuecomment-506790740).

**Result**

* [Without it](https://develop--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce/?refinementList%5Bbrand%5D%5B0%5D=HP\&refinementList%5Bbrand%5D%5B1%5D=Speck\&refinementList%5Bbrand%5D%5B2%5D=Epson): ← open it on small browser.
  ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/499898/60442813-2546f200-9c1a-11e9-9c2e-47afbb10b67d.png)

* [With it](https://deploy-preview-3913--instantsearchjs.netlify.com/examples/e-commerce/?refinementList%5Bbrand%5D%5B0%5D=HP\&refinementList%5Bbrand%5D%5B1%5D=Speck\&refinementList%5Bbrand%5D%5B2%5D=Epson): ← open it on small browser.
  ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/499898/60442861-3f80d000-9c1a-11e9-89b4-f013e34af01f.png)
